screening_rule: OpenAlex search is intentionally broad and includes reviews, preprints, duplicates, visual-tactile studies, auditory-only studies, VR/haptic studies, dissertations, modeling papers, and non-PPS audiotactile tasks. The tracked audit promotes only records that plausibly contain an audio-plus-tactile PPS task or alter an already known PPS task family.
